summary: Iter 154 — FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) integration tested end-to-end. Backend SDK init verified (project=homeme-xzveg), all 7 endpoints (status/register/unregister/tokens/send/test/logs) working with auth, role guards, idempotent upsert, multi-device per user, graceful no-tokens handling, fake-token failure path, audit logging, and paginated logs filter. Frontend /app/fcm dashboard renders all 15 testids, stats tiles, Flutter guide, send/test forms, delivery logs; sidebar entry 'إشعارات Push (FCM)' present.
critical_code_review_comments: fcm_service.py keeps _initialized as a module-level flag; if firebase_admin.get_app() succeeds but project_id isn't yet read (e.g., second call branch), get_project_id() works because _init_firebase reloads JSON each call when not initialized — acceptable but could be tightened.

routes/fcm.py role check '_can_manage' allows app_owner/super_admin/company_admin/admin. Consider whether company_admin should be able to push to ANY user across compounds or only their own — currently no compound scoping. Flag for future enhancement (not a bug for this iter).
seed_data_creation: No seed required; tests register/unregister tokens within the same flow and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FCM backend layer fully validated with fake tokens (real delivery requires a Flutter app). Public URL test verified at https://profile-nav-debug.preview.emergentagent.com. All 7 endpoints + UI dashboard working. Owner login uses mandatory 2FA — use pyotp with provided secret. After 2FA, navigate directly to /app/fcm; the dashboard loads and lists 1 registered device + 9 prior log entries (failures, as expected from earlier test runs with fake tokens).
